text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for making you waste your time
treating
my injury...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: Don't worry about that. How's the pain?

text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. It's nothing to look so worried
over.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'm barely even hurt. It's minor enough
for me to
be able to treat myself...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: I still want to help with whatever I can.
This is all part of a trainer's job.

text_block_list.text:
I'm barely even hurt. It's minor enough
for me to
be able to treat myself...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: I still want to help with whatever I can.
This is all part of a trainer's job.

text_block_list.text:
Oh my, I can't turn down such an
adorable offer
like that.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
But really, please don't worry about me.
I'll be
better in no time.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: It hurts me more to see you upset.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Of course, I suppose I'm the cause of it...
So I'm
sorry for making you worry.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Trainer...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: I understand. Then I'm in your care.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I really do love the cool and
dependable
side of you too.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Who's a good Тренер?! Yes, you are!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Oh, deary me. What a surprise!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
You're usually so cute, but now you've
got this
serious look of maturity on your
face...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: My heart... It won't stop pounding!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Hehe... Thank you, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to train with everything
I've got
once I'm all better.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик forces a smile, but she still
seems
down. She pats my head as I take
care of her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I cheer up the demoralized Супер Крик
so that
she rests peacefully.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик smiles with joy as I tend to
her injury.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
